action.action-desc: Mrs. Bice (for herself and Mr. Womack) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform, and in addition to the Committee on Armed Services, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned

form.official-title: To amend titles 41 and 10, United States Code, to prohibit a requirement or preference for the use of union labor for Federal contracts.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the No Preference Act.

section.header: Federal contracting prohibition for executive agencies to require or give a preference for union labor

subsection.text: Chapter 47 of title 41, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following new section:

section.header: Prohibition on requirement or preference for the use of union labor
section.text: The head of an executive agency may not require or give preference to an offeror on the basis of whether the offeror will use workers subject to a collective bargaining agreement.

subsection.text: The table of sections for chapter 47 of title 41, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following new item:

toc.toc-entry: Sec. 4715. Prohibition on requirement or preference for the use of union labor.

section.header: Defense contracting requirement to use union labor
section.text: Chapter 243 of title 10, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following:
The Secretary of Defense may not require or give preference to an offeror for a contract on the basis of whether the offeror will use workers subject to a collective bargaining agreement.
